race.comment: ROCHEDALE HERO (1) returned in good order with a solid placing at the Sunny Coast and does boast a win around this circuit. Gets the services of Maloney in the stirrups and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. The well-related BUCKEYE (2) (full to G3 winner Amelita) has a handy record over this distance range with a win and a second from just two attempts. Strips fitter second-up from the break and can make his presence felt. ABRAHAM (3) has placed two from two over this trip and will be ready to peak now third run back. Watch for a spike in form. CAMBRIDGE BAY (4) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Worth another chance. ROSA KISS (8) is a last-start winner who shouldn't slept on.
